commercial.title: The High-Ticket Closing Playbook
commercial.description: The manager playbook for high-ticket teams: diagnose stalled deals, protect margin, create authentic urgency, and place a discounted travel voucher accurately.
commercial.lead: When a confident buyer hesitates, the fastest way to lose margin is to cut price. This manager playbook gives your team a repeatable way to diagnose stalled deals, protect margin, and place a discounted travel voucher accurately in the close.

sections.p: The playbook walks managers through the eight-stage high-ticket closing process, six questions for diagnosing stalled deals, a manager-ready objection framework, word-for-word price and urgency questions, when a discounted travel voucher can and cannot help, a 21-day launch and measurement plan, and a revenue scorecard for close rate, margin, pipeline, and commission.

sections.h: Built for managers who sell high-ticket products
sections.p: It is written for owners, sales leaders, dealer principals, and managers whose teams need to close qualified buyers without reflexively cutting price. The discounted travel voucher is never positioned as a substitute for product value — representatives first diagnose fit, value, affordability, authority, timing, trust, and implementation before introducing added value.

sections.h: Put it to work on your sales floor
sections.p: Use the playbook in a weekly stalled-deal review, a rep role-play, or a controlled campaign test. The included scorecard measures qualified close rate, cycle time, average order value, discounting, gross profit, cancellations, attributable revenue, and commission — so you can see whether it creates profitable sales.
